newsitem.title: USA: Allstate unit prices preferred securities.
newsitem.headline: Allstate unit prices preferred securities.

text.p: Allstate Corp said Wednesday its Allstate Financing Trust I subsidiary trust priced $500 million worth of Series A Cumulative Quarterly Income Preferred Securities (QUIPS) at $25 per share.

Holders will be entitled to cash distributions at an annual rate of 7.95 percent, Allstate said. The securities will mature on December 31, 2026, unless Allstate exercises an option to extend the maturation date to December 31, 2045.
The securities, which are rated A by Standard & Poor's and a2 by Moody's Investors Service, will trade on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol ALL Pr A.
Allstate Corp is the parent of Allstate Insurance Co, the nation's largest publicly held insurance underwriter.
